notes.title: Tremors
notes.content:
[h1]Cave Update[/h1]

[i]You feel the Earth move, the floor beneath you groans and rumbles as if alive. You are certain that something below shifted, but what, or who, caused it?[/i]

The seismic event caused the Werewolf cave to collapse in on itself, revealing an elaborate cave system. 

[h3]The Werewolves now have a new home.[/h3]

[h2]Before[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/e6efd29e81dab91a687b62b97a4c02573c2dc0f9.jpg[/img]

[h2]After[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/698cc75f9faf8aee2c950dd2e5ecdeed45c09497.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/c1e1481f5690096739590c6bf7472d2fb4acbb9e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Notification System[/h1]
A new and experimental notification system makes it's debut.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/4550398d5f231087103df0fb53758a1c739f15dc.jpg[/img]

[h1]Sound Controls[/h1]
You can now individually adjust the volume of different sound types in the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/789b7bed6e16f946e3ceac1716d0c5736c91ee6e.png[/img]

[h1]Roles[/h1]

[h2]Serial Killer[/h2]
The Serial Killer has always felt like a less interesting version of the Cannibal. I'm reworking him with a focus on his need to kill.

[list]
[*] Notoriety resource has been replaced with Blood Lust.
[*] Begins the game with 5 Blood Lust, and loses 1 per night.
[*] If he ever reaches 0 Blood Lust he is removed from the game.
[*] Still strikes players with an unstoppable attack if he can predict who they are targeting.
[*] Now granted 1 Blood Lust for each successful kill.
[*] Now untargetable at night.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ec4b3da7b0fcdcc355f900b6f8f27da582c8d2b9.jpg[/img]

[h2]Arsonist[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer ignites two players.
[*] Now ignites one player, and their targets.
[*] No longer has permanent defence.
[*] Now only protected from fire.
[/list]
[h2]Night Owl[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now only invites 3 players to her Moon Party
[/list]

notes.title: Freezing Time
notes.content:
[h1]Night Phases[/h1]
Night is now split into two distinct phases, [b]Action [/b]and [b]Resolution[/b].

[h2]Action[/h2]
[list]
[*] Time limited.
[*] Players may use their abilities.
[/list][h2]Resolution[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players may no longer use their abilities.
[*] Abilities have their effect in the following order:  [b]Manipulation [/b]> [b]Detection [/b]> [b]Protection [/b]> [b]Elimination[/b].
[/list]
This means there will no longer be ambiguity when deciding how abilities interact with each other.

[h1]Haven[/h1]
Haven's outside area has been updated, now featuring a waterfall, ambient sounds and lighting.

[h2]Before[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/3d6c5699130b76966129af9fbe639a5ace44efef.jpg[/img]
[h2]After[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/8ca4e5484f3ca53b1752067d921da946c6d214e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Locations[/h1]
The Garden location has been reworked and is now called the Clearing.

[h2]Before[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/491be1ad653794c9eba216be75454fe707939977.jpg[/img]
[h2]After[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/1728010a5c4e20deef75463cf6926a50db1482eb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mod Menu[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added the ability to remove a player's role.
[*] Added the ability to end a game, revealing all roles.
[/list]
[h1]Small Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a skull to dead player's nametags.
[*] Slightly reduced the size of role cards (thanks fem!).
[*] You can now see revealed roles on the Home screen.
[*] Added several ambient sound effects.
[/list]
[h1]Roles[/h1]
The goal of this update is to make less popular roles more appealing, thematic, and easier to mod. To begin, the 'encased in ice' and 'fragile' keywords have been removed from the game, and all frost roles have been reworked.

[h2]Frost Mage[/h2]
[list]
[*] Blizzard has been removed
[*] Encased in Ice has been reworked into Ice Block.
[*] New ability - Frost bolt
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/aaa515cb8b4f0dd2e16eb681e5bb5ea65f8795b9.jpg[/img]
[h2]Frost Wolf[/h2]
[list]
[*] Encased in ice has been reworked into Frost Claws.
[*] New ultimate - Blizzard.
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/5f204717a44f087e25722308d632c5bcb100293d.jpg[/img]
[h2]Frost Drake [/h2]
[list]
[*] A new Dragon has awoken from a century long slumber. (Thank you Gracie for the art!)
[/list][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/1f93531650455f7001885fd7339df1383328ed69.jpg[/img]

[h1]Additional Reworks[/h1]
[h2]Dragon[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer lays in wait, unleashing an attack if lynched.
[*] No longer has Latent Heat as a resource.
[*] Now has a nightly 3 player wide blazing attack.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/d48f5b93c2803ea05a5b3e65500188195ce34915.jpg[/img]
[h2]Dragon Knight[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now Lesser Evil.
[*] Now leaves attackers ignited.
[*] Now redirects attacks from a player onto himself.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/7ec66ae130fb709d377397e268d8eacea2067992.jpg[/img]
[h2]Plague Doctor[/h2]
[list]
[*] Plague is now permanent.
[*] Plague is now only spread to the players targeting a player with plague.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/76faffcc91eb2d6222139afdcdb16f03fa52e50e.jpg[/img]
[h2]Ringmaster[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now Neutral.
[*] Now causes a single player to roll the dice of death, with it having a random effect.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/a36b75c054f441bd26b2c8ad700619f8ea2993e8.jpg[/img]
[h2]Starving Wolf[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer causes the Werewolves to not be able to eliminate for a night on death.
[*] Now causes all Werewolves to only be able to attack their neighbours.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ef8e3f8271e92b939246e7b52417d465a2f1fec0.jpg[/img]
[h2]Weresheep[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer makes players appear as Sheep.
[*] Now turns a player into a Sheep (1 charge).
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/c7d52286dc446bdde07fd664df380cd86355a2e1.jpg[/img]
[h2]Werwolf Horror[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer called the Werewolf Horror, now just the Horror.
[*] No longer forbids words.
[*] Now scares all targets off of a player.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/36c61b314c649100a0f4133ee8fca926c3f4ebdf.jpg[/img]

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]
[h2]Death[/h2]
[list]
[*] Death's Divine Protection proc now costs 2 souls instead of 1.
[/list]
[h2]Dracula[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer has permanent defense.
[*] Converted players no longer learn who dracula is.
[*] Dracula no longer learns the role of converted players.
[/list]
[h2]Healer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now uses mana.
[*] Gains 50 mana per night.
[*] Heal costs 25 mana.
[/list]
[h2]Juggernaut[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer stands guard at a player's house.
[*] Now has a devastating 3 player wide attack (1 charge).
[/list]
[h2]Justice[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can no longer get justice on players that survive attacks, now only accusations.
[/list]
[h2]Locksmith[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer roleblocks his target.
[/list]
[h2]Tormenter[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer role blocks players.
[*] Now causes a player to target her instead of their original target/s.
[/list]
[h2]Necromancer[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed.
[/list]
[h2]Wolf Cub[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer grows up into a Werewolf of his choice.
[*] Now grants the Werewolves an additional attack on death.
[/list]

notes.title: Role Sets
notes.content:
[h1]Sets[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added support for additional official and community role sets.
[*] Added official Starter Set.
[/list]

[h1]Roles[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Medium
[*] Added Druid
[/list]

[h1]UI[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added red tint to selected menu title.
[/list]

[h1]Tavern[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved lighting.

[/list]

[list]

[list]

notes.title: Hearing Things
notes.content:
[h1]Tavern[/h1]
[list]
[*] It's cold in here. Has someone left the front door open?
[/list]

[h1]UI Sound Effects[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added several sound effects to the user interface. 
[/list]

[h1]Player Houses[/h1]
[list]
[*] You can now enter player houses regardless if they are claimed or not.
[*] You now only see your role once the game begins.
[/list]

[h1]Voice Chat[/h1]
[list]
[*] Globally increased the volume of all voice chat by 1.5x.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing your menu to close when pressing spacebar after clicking to view a role.
[*] Fixed issues with player collision.
[*] Fixed an issue causing nametags to not always render.
[*] Fixed a bug causing your voice to stop transmitting if you close your menu.
[/list]

[h1]Roles[/h1]

[h2]Den Mother[/h2]
[list]
[*] No longer redirects attacks on other Werewolves to herself. 
[*] Can now protect a player at night (but never herself)
[/list]

[h2]Dragon Knight[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now part of Dragon Group.
[*] Now Neutral.
[*] Now has permanent defense.
[*] Now redirects attacks on his target to himself.
[/list]

[h2]Death[/h2]
[list]
[*] Now gains 1 soul when another player dies.
[*] Now denies all role reveals.
[*] Is no longer untargetable at night.

notes.title: Seeing Things
notes.content:
[h1]Targeting[/h1]
[list]
[*] Multi target abilities now track how many targets you have and display current target count compared to expected target count.
[*] Players selected whilst targeting are now highlighted in your faciton's colour.
[*] Abilities now consider target restrictions when targeting.
[/list]
[h2]Curent Restrictions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can I target alive/dead players
[*] Can I target myself 
[*] Can I target a player on consecutive nights
[*] Can I target more than once per game
[/list][h2]Future Retrictions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players affected by a certain ability
[*] Players of a certain faction/class/role group
[/list]

[h1]Mod Menu[/h1]
[list]
[*] Permanent and persistent abilities are now shown to the moderator. 
[*] A random role assignment button has been added allowing the moderator to assign a random role to a selected house (or random house if no player is selected).
[/list]

[h1]Nametags[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug causing nametags to now always show up.
[*] Added a player's house number to their nametag if they own a house.
[*] Added a star to the moderator's nametag.
[*] Increased the size of the talking border to make it more obvious when a player is speaking.
[*] Added a roleout animation that animates the player's name appearing once they are close enough.
[*] Nametags are now occluded when a player is behind an object.
[/list]

[h1]Haven[/h1]
[list]
[*] Closed off both sides of the area outside to players alive in the game
[*] Added a cave outside
[/list]

[h1]Player Character[/h1]
[list]
[*] Removed bra from female player model when not naked.
[*] You can now leave your house at night if dead.
[/list]

[h1]Voice Chat[/h1]
[list]
[*] Extended the range at which players can hear you
[/list]

[h1]New Role Art[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fire Mage
[*] Hag
[*] Seer
[*] Justice
[*] Mirror Fiend
[*] Cannibal
[/list]

notes.title: Passion
notes.content:
[h1]Locations[/h1]
The 3 existing locations have undergone a major overhaul, now boasting new visuals and themes. The locations system has also been upgraded to allow for new locations in the future.

[h2]Throne Room[/h2]
A large and elaborate structure intended for larger groups that focus on a single player, such as the Royals or Cult.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/08dc97bebfac1cdcb35f800179a4a6f6c5fb5b35.png[/img]

[h2]Cellar[/h2]
A dark and intimate space intended for two players with an undertone of danger, such as the Jailer or Information Broker.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/f6293e5dc903d1079dfda3f5c1f116740924822e.png[/img]

[h2]Garden[/h2]
A beautiful and open garden intended for larger groups in a relaxed and (mostly) friendly environment, such as for a Moon Party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/81681d67c2893a60509b4b0aa0586f24d580cc84.png[/img]

[h1]Player Houses[/h1]
Players may no longer leave their houses at night and now respawn at home.

[h1]Sessions[/h1]
Sessions have been upgraded to allow for Steam invites and joining on friends via your friends list.
Additionally sessions now have join permissions, specficially:
[list]
[*] Invite Only - Only players invited via steam can join.
[*] Friends - Only friends can join.
[*] Public - Anyone can join.
[/list]
[h1]User Interface[/h1]
The user interface has been redesigned and rebuilt with a focus on simplicity and functionality. Notably the icons on the Nav Bar have been replaced with titles to improve readability.

[h2]Home[/h2]
A new screen providing an overview of the session that you are currently in. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/44ac38b3653f4fd64cb3b01ad33791326c8c8c1c.jpg[/img]

[h2]Worlds[/h2]
Browse existing sessions or create your own for other players to join.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/a7b4ef35c12c2e28cac8f37d485bafe817f96294.jpg[/img]

[h2]Roles[/h2]
A new layout with improved filtering and a new on-hover element showing the hovered role's faction.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ed61045ba7b1a41db562d45f9d9d1604a6dde962.jpg[/img]

[h2]Role Details[/h2]
A new role details screen with a simplified design.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/9a09a038b92589a7d6a6ddaf1442d5efd8c0e795.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/0fbe1536d46e6ebde03686e2e0726aaf1b670b95.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/78533b9830a8912ad0e5f751dab6130c22d2f2fe.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/d9f67f0645bb527e0c58712808179c45058f4d83.jpg[/img]

[h2]Nametags[/h2]
Nametags have been heavily optimized and you no longer see your own nametag, additionally your nametag no longer dims when crouching.

[h1]Targeting[/h1]
Targeting has been redesigned and is now included in a new role panel that provides all the information about your role at the bottom of your screen.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/4f06eccf2c52e04d1975d194888c4fec84b5f51b.jpg[/img]

[h1]Mod Menu[/h1]
Finally, the new mod menu makes a debut. Whilst still a work in progress it completely replaces the old menu with new features such as random role asignment, resource control, and teleporting to locations.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/bb81f995452e9b160e477edb3779727b6cf9056a.jpg[/img]

[h1]Worlds[/h1]
The stonemasons are at it again!

[h2]Tavern[/h2]
The cellar has opened up, but it seems to be flooded?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/31f70f4380ab1f46092cf4de908dfcd8376e506a.png[/img]

[h2]Haven[/h2]
Haven has been opened up and now has a mote, cliff faces, and a market outside!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/51a039c3a2ca3bb7938920f10f90cf2aee104b34.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/9165f98c091fa6d62006b46e84a861ae1a2cb868.png[/img]

[h1]Roles[/h1]

[h2]Role Groups[/h2]
A new and optional attribute that groups certain roles together. There are currently two role groups, Royals and Dragons
[list]
[*] Royals - A privileged circle of influential figures who meet in secret each night, their elevated status granting them unique insights and actions that shape the course of the game.
[*] Dragons - A powerful conclave who meet under the veil of night, their combined strength and ancient wisdom a force to be reckoned with.
[/list]
[h2]New Art[/h2]
[list]
[*] Alpha Wolf
[*] Dracula
[*] Frost Mage
[*] Princess
[/list]
[h2]New Roles[/h2]

[h3]Cupid[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/58067e3c1df6b524b08a77fa7073c75c3a394a7b.jpg[/img]

[h3]Magistrate[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/f88c4e420e2603a11650dd41d9d7c976a921deaa.jpg[/img]

[h2]Role Changes[/h2]

[h3]Arsonist[/h3]
Firey Retaliation (permanent defense) now ignites attackers.

[h3]Assassin[/h3]
Now always untargetable at night

[h3]Baby Dragon[/h3]
Now removes 1 player if killed during day
	
[h3]Bard[/h3]
Serenade charges 3 -> 2

[h3]Corrupt Noble[/h3]
No longer assumes the role of the evil player he meets with.
Now meets with the Werewolves if there are no Evil players alive.

[h3]Council Elder[/h3]
No longer changes player's faction to neutral
Now adds a player to the council each night, meets with the council at night.
Now wins when anyone part of the council wins.

[h3]Cow[/h3]
No longer turns a player into a cow on death.
Now causes poison to spread to a random player each night

[h3]Creep[/h3]
Now learns his neighbours classes instead of roles.
No longer reveals his identity to Evils/Werewolves that he stalks.

[h3]Dark Seer[/h3]
Learnt role is no longer shared with evils and werewolves.

[h3]Death[/h3]
No longer gets divine protection if fated to die, is now untargetable at night.
No longer marks players for death making them exposed.
Now automatically harvest's a player's soul on lynch, denying their role reveal
Now wins after harvesting 3 player's souls.

[h3]Dracula[/h3]
Now only learns a player's role if they are Town

[h3]Dragon Knight[/h3]
Is now Town
No longer becomes a dragon if attacked
Now kills his attacker if killed.

[h3]Fire Dragon[/h3]
Cataclysm now kills one player per two latent heat
	
[h3]Frost Mage[/h3]
Blizzard no longer ultimate, now costs 60 mana

[h3]Guardian Angel[/h3]
No longer protects herself alongside her target with divine protection, but can now target herself.

[h3]Greenhorn[/h3]
No longer reveals a player's role on death.
Now has permanent defense.

[h3]Juggernaut[/h3]
Now kills anyone who visits his target.

[h3]Old Man[/h3]
Attacks are no longer always unstoppable, he is now permanently exposed
Can no longer alert at night, now attacks a player twice if lynched. 

[h2]Ringmaster[/h2]
Loser no longer dies, is now forcibly accused.

[h2]Tormenter[/h2]
No longer enhances evil players.
Now roleblocks, regardless of faction.

notes.title: Welcome Home
notes.content:
[h2][b]A New Home[/b][/h2]
[list]
Player houses have undergone intense renovation, boasting a brand new interior featuring themed entrances for the cave, royal chamber, cellar and back garden.
[/list]
[h2][b]Interaction System[/b][/h2]
[list]
The interaction system has been redesigned to allow for interactable objects to have multiple functions. 

This new system is now being used for player house doors, allowing the house to be claimed or entered, however this system can be expanded to allow for player voting in the future.

The interaction system has also been heavily optimized, more specifically it only checks for objects that are interactable and does so once every few miliseconds instead of on each frame.
[/list]
[h2][b]Roles[/b][/h2]
[h3]New Role Art[/h3]
[list]
[*]Corrupt Noble
[*]Council Elder
[*]Creep
[*]Dark Seer
[*]Magus
[*]Plague Doctor
[*]Royal Knight
[*]Skeletal Wolf
[*]Wolf Girl
[/list]
[h3]Dracula[/h3]
[list]
[*]No Longer attacks a player at night.
[*]Now learns the role of his target and turns them into a lesser evil if they are town.
[/list]

notes.title: Fall
notes.content:
[h2][b]User Interface[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added a welcome message to welcome new players.

[*]Added an animation when hovering over roles in the roles menu.

[/list]
[h2][b]Roles[/b][/h2]
[h3]Baby Dragon[/h3]

[*]No longer activates the Dragon's ability on death.
[*]Now meets with all alive Dragons.

[/list]
[h3]Bard[/h3]
[list]
[*]Serenade now has 3 charges.
[*]Spectacle Reworked - Now permanently enhances a player instead of enhancing the entire town.
[/list]
[h3]Blood Fiend[/h3]
[list]
[*]Now has permanent defense.
[/list]
[h3]Blood Mage[/h3]
[list]
[*]Sacrifice (Divine Protection) - Removed.
[/list]
[h3]Council Elder[/h3]
[list]
[*]No longer adds players to a council that performs a special accusation before announcements.
[*]Now adds two players to a secret council. Their factions are changed to neutral and the council meets at night.
[/list]
[h3]Cow[/h3]

notes.title: Obsession
notes.content:
[h2][b]Targeting 1.0[/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Added night targeting, allowing players to target other players with their abilities at night.
[*]There are currently 5 types of abilities:
[list]
[*][b]On the first night[/b] abilities, such as the Guardian Angel's bind, which will only allow the player to target on the first night.
[*][b]Each Night[/b] abilities, such as the Bodyguard's protect, which have no cost and can be used once per night.
[*]Abilities with a certain amount of [b]charges[/b], such as the Shield Maiden's protect, that can be used a certain amount of times per game.
[*]Abilities that cost [b]resources[/b], such as the Fire Mage's fireball, that require the player to have enough of a certain resource to use the ability.
[*][b]Ultimates[/b], such as the Chronomancer's paradox, which can only be used once per game.[/list]
[*]Permanent effects are carried over to the next day, where as non permanent effects can always be viewed via target history.
[*]Targeting currently decides 'Can I target' for a player. Deciding based on your ability's type, if it costs anything, your resources, if you've already used it, etc to decide if you can use the ability.
[*]In the future targeting will also take into account 'Who can I target'. Restricting available targets to valid/allowed targets. For example the grave digger should only ever target dead players, and the bodyguard should not be able to target himself.
[/list]

[h2][b]Roles [/b][/h2]
[list]
[*]Drunk, Jester and Lord have all been removed from the game.[/list]
[h3]Psychopath[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Now grants himself and his obsession permanent defense.
[*]No longer collects blood to paint masterpieces.
[*]Has a new resource, rage.
[*]Each player that visits his obsession generates 1 rage.
[*]Daytime elimination of a player that previously visited your obsession will cause you to lose 1 rage.
[*]If he reaches max rage (5) he will kill his obsession target, and himself, losing the game.
[*]He now wins the game if his obsession and himself are the only players left alive.
[/list]
[h3]Blood Mage[/h3] 
[list]
[*]No longer gains blood charges when people die.
[*]Has a new ability, drain, which allows him to leave a player bleeding and gain a blood charge each night.
[/list]
[h3]Dragon[/h3] 
[list]
[*]No longer gains Dragon Fire whenever attacked at night.
[*]Now passively gains 1 Dragon Fire each night.
[*]Cataclysm now kills players equal to the Dragon's Dragon Fire
[/list]
[h3]Royal Guard[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Can no longer reveal himself to save a Royal's life during the day.
[*]Now grants Divine Protection instead of a basic protection.
[/list]
[h3]Council Elder[/h3] 
[list]
[*]The Council no longer perform a special acusation phase before announcements, they now vote to spare or eliminate the Council Elder's acusation target without discussion.
[/list]
[h3]Jailer[/h3] 
[list]
[*]Is now no longer revealed if they execute a Townsfolk.
[/list]
[h3]Wolf Girl[/h3] 
[list]
[*]No longer sees who her target visits at night. Reverted back to learning her target's capabilities. (Thanks Elder!)
[/list]
[h3]Werewolf Scholar[/h3] 
[list]
[*]No longer learns his target's capabilities, now learns his target's role instead.
[/list]
[h3]Spy[/h3] 
[list]
[*]No longer asks the moderator if a question they posed during the day was answered truthfully.
[*]Now appears to investigation as the faction that investigates him, and learns the identity of the player who investigated him.
[*]Can now poison anyone, but only once per game.
[/list]

notes.title: Its Wednesday My Dudes
notes.content:
[ [b]Sky[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Replaced complex simulated volumetric clouds with a 2D cloud skybox. 
[*] Clouds now randomize at the start of every in game day.
[*] Adjusted the colour of the sky to better match the stylized game style.
[*] Built a custom Werewolf sky system that allows for control over the different day phases. (The very first step of targetting!)
[/list]

[ [b]Lighting[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Rebuilt the lighting system from the ground up.
[*] Replaced a moving 'Sun' dynamic light with 3 static light positions for Day, Dusk and Night. (This vastly improves performance and allows for better lighting whilst appearing exactly the same in game.)
[*] Replaced a dynamic sky light that would react to the sky's ambient lighting with 3 static and pre-baked sky lights (baked for the 3 day phases). Vastly improving performance and lighting quality.
[*] Brightened up dusk and the evening to help with visibility and to better match the game's style.
[/list]

[ [b]Main Menu[/b] ]
[list]
[*] Removed empty box disguised as a castle.
[*] Built a brand new Tavern!
[*] The intention is for the Tavern to be a 'staging ground' for groups to get together before they move to a game map to play. (This will be added next update)
[*] The tavern is not fully furnished and has loads of areas that will open up in the future.
[/list]

notes.title: Who said what?
notes.content:

[/list]
